content.title: Fallen Officers Memorial
content.summary: The Arvada Police Department honors four officers who have died in the line of duty with the Arvada Police Honor Garden, dedicated in 2026. The fallen officers include Robert G. Beghtol, who died in 1961 during training; W. Michael Northey, who was struck by a vehicle in 1979; Gordon Beesley, who was killed in 2021; and Dillon Vakoff, who lost his life responding to a disturbance in 2022.
content.body:
During the course of the Arvada Police Department's history, four officers have been killed in the line of duty. The [Arvada Police Honor Garden](https://www.arvadaco.gov/1500/Arvada-Police-Honor-Garden), a permanent memorial to Arvada's fallen officers, was constructed and dedicated in 2026.

## [Officer Robert G. Beghtol](/578)

Officer Beghtol started his career with the Arvada Police Department on December 15, 1958. He came to the Arvada Police Department after serving in the United States Army. On July 28, 1961, Officer Beghtol died during Scuba Diving Unit practice at the lake near 60th and Tennyson.

## [Officer W. Michael Northey](/581)

Officer Mike Northey joined the Arvada Police Department on February 20, 1978. He was tragically struck by a vehicle after he stopped two motorcycle riders on August 11, 1979 and died two days later. There is an Arvada park named after Officer Northey.

## [Officer Gordon Beesley](/576)

On Monday, June 21, 2021, an unspeakable tragedy took place in our community. During that terrible event, an Arvada Police officer gave his life in service to our community.

## [Officer Dillon Vakoff](/582)

Officer Dillon Vakoff joined the Arvada Police Department in 2019. He was training to be a SWAT officer. Officer Vakoff came to us after serving six years in the Air Force. He was a 2012 graduate of Ralston Valley High School. He was killed in the line of duty while responding to a disturbance call on Sept. 11, 2022.
